Test your mettle against the [[gargoyle]]s running amok in Old Ascalon.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = warrior
}}

===Objectives===
* Kill 5 [[Shatter Gargoyle|Shatter]] or [[Flash Gargoyle]]s.  You have killed 0..5 gargoyles.
* Return to Warmaster Grast for your reward.

===Reward===
* 200 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Wild Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Sever Artery}}
* {{skill icon|Gash}}
* {{skill icon|Healing Signet}}

==Walkthrough==
There are several Gargoyles throughout Old Ascalon. You will most likely find enough nearby when you accept this quest. Just slay enough gargoyles and claim your reward for your deeds. Be aware of the [[Hex Spell]] "[[Conjure Phantasm]]" of the Shatter Gargoyles and the [[Air Magic]] [[Spell]] "[[Lightning Orb]]" of the Flash Gargoyles, these two can be devastating to an unprepared and inexperienced hero.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Warmaster Grast
:''"A true Warrior's got to be tough to survive in Ascalon after the Searing.  You've got to show me some prowess in battle before I acknowledge you as a true Warrior.  Defeating '''5''' of these shatter or flash '''gargoyles''' should be a true test of your mettle.  Think you can handle it?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = That should be no problem.
| decline = No, not really.
| ask = What are you waiting for?  Kill 5 shatter or flash '''gargoyles'''… or are you having trouble counting that high?
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Warmaster Grast
:''"I'll admit you did better than I expected.  Well done!"''

==Notes==
* It's easy to complete this quest while working on [[Counting the Fallen]] due to the number of flash and shatter gargoyles roaming in the area.
